subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice intake preference (Acme Systems) — portal vs email
summary: Decision thread to confirm Redwood AP intake: prefer ProcurePlus portal with email fallback; clarified required invoice fields and PO stamping workflow; vendor provided updated template and sample PDF.
messages:
From: Acme Systems Billing <billing@acme.example.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New vendor setup — invoice intake for Redwood Inference

Hi Mina,

We are ready to start sending invoices for the recently-approved contract (PO PO-44321). Can you confirm the preferred channel for invoice submission — should we upload to your portal (ProcurePlus) or continue emailing invoices to AP?

Attached: acme_invoice_template_v1.xlsx; sample_invoice_pdf_example.pdf

Also: is there a required invoice layout (fields we must include) and do you need vendor tax ID and remit-to information on each invoice?

Thanks,
Carla Ruiz
Billing Manager, Acme Systems
billing@acme.example.com

--
Attachment: acme_invoice_template_v1.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, 34KB)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Acme Systems Billing <billing@acme.example.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup — invoice intake for Redwood Inference

Hi Carla —

Thanks for sending the template. Short answer: we prefer vendors to use the ProcurePlus portal for routine invoices (it gives us PO matching and automatic GL mapping). We do allow email submission as a fallback for the first 2 months while onboarding is finishing. To make sure invoices process cleanly, please include these fields on every invoice:

- Redwood PO number (exact match to PO on header)
- Line-item description, qty, unit price, and total per line
- Tax ID / VAT number for the vendor
- 'Remit to' address and bank details (if wired)

If you can re-send using the template with the PO populated and a one-line sample for line-item mapping that would speed validation.

Cc'ing Marissa and Ben to confirm the portal enablement and exception path.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Vendor Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Acme Systems Billing <billing@acme.example.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T15:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup — invoice intake for Redwood Inference

Mina / Marissa —

Recommend we set Acme up on ProcurePlus as the primary channel. Quick decision logic I suggest:

- High-volume, recurring vendor -> portal
- Single/irregular vendors -> email OK, but require PO stamping workflow
- If vendor cannot map fields exactly, we do a one-off field-mapping with ProcurePlus (takes ~48 hours)

I'll attach the AP integration checklist and a short mapping table. For this vendor specifically (PO-44321) I think portal + 2-week email fallback is fine.

Ben
Director, Supplier Ops
ben_carter@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: ap_integration_checklist.docx (Checklist, 12KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Acme Systems Billing <billing@acme.example.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup — invoice intake for Redwood Inference

Carla / team —

Confirming internal policy: we require the vendor Tax ID and PO number on every invoice. If Acme needs an exception (e.g., for one-off consultants or international VAT formatting) notify procurement with an explanation and expected window. Exception approvals live with Procurement and may add a 5-7 business day hold.

Action items for Acme:
1) Register at ProcurePlus: https://procureplus.io/vendor/AcmeSystems (we'll provision access).
2) Upload the filled invoice template once registered.
3) For the next 2 weeks you may email invoices to ap@redwood.ai but mark the subject "VENDOR SUBMISSION: Acme Systems — PO-44321".

Marissa Cole
Sr. Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: New vendor setup — invoice intake for Redwood Inference

Carla —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Next steps (mutual action plan):

1) ProcurePlus onboarding: Acme to register at https://procureplus.io/vendor/AcmeSystems by EOD Apr 15. Ben will send the portal invitation and mapping file.
2) Upload the attached filled template to ProcurePlus. If mapping complaints arise, ProcurePlus integration team will reconcile within 48 hours.
3) Email fallback: send invoices to ap@redwood.ai with subject line exactly: "VENDOR SUBMISSION: Acme Systems — PO-44321" for up to 2 weeks after portal access is live. Failure to include PO will trigger manual hold.
4) Exceptions: submit a procurement exception request to marissa_cole@redwood.ai; expect 5-7 business day review.

Inline sample mapping (please mirror these column headers exactly in your upload):
PO Number | Line Description | Qty | Unit Price | Line Total | Tax ID | Remit Name
PO-44321  | Consulting — runtime tuning | 1 | 25,000.00 | 25,000.00 | 12-3456789 | Acme Systems, Inc.

Attached: ap_integration_checklist.docx; sample_invoice_pdf_example.pdf

I'll close the loop once I see the ProcurePlus registration + first uploaded invoice.

Best regards,
Mina Haddad
